title: Design System: Specimen Register — Presentation Palette

display.purpose: Identifies the catalogue in the masthead.

title.purpose: Labels the document pane and catalogue columns.

label.purpose: Names editor fields and primary controls.

status.purpose: Keeps inventory state legible inside the status marker.

code.purpose: Shows editable Specs and the MongoDB document preview.

motion.name: control-state
motion.purpose: Button color and border changes and catalogue row state changes.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Shortens transitions and animations when reduced motion is requested.

breakpoints.name: title-compact
breakpoints.purpose: Tightens page gutters, editor columns, and title sizing.

breakpoints.name: mobile-cards
breakpoints.purpose: Stacks filters, changes catalogue rows to product cards, and stacks record panes.

breakpoints.name: masthead-narrow
breakpoints.purpose: Stacks the masthead title and sample marker.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Presentation-teal action for adding or saving a product.
components.css: .ds-button { min-height: 48px; padding: 0 22px; border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong); border-radius: 5px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); font: 700 18px/1 Assistant, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease, color 120ms ease, transform 100ms ease; } .ds-button:hover { background: #D6F3EC; } .ds-button:active { transform: scale(.985); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button-primary { border-color: var(--accent); background: var(--accent); color: #fff; } .ds-button-primary:hover { border-color: #12302B; background: #12302B; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Quiet outlined control for canceling or other secondary form actions.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { min-height: 48px; padding: 0 22px; border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong); border-radius: 5px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); font: 700 18px/1 Assistant, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease, color 120ms ease, transform 100ms ease; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { background: #D6F3EC; } .ds-button-secondary:active { transform: scale(.985); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Filter
components.description: Joined label and search field used to scan the product index.
components.css: .ds-search { min-width: 0; height: 48px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 130px minmax(0, 1fr); color: var(--ink); font-family: Assistant, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-search-label { display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 27px; border-radius: 4px 0 0 4px; background: var(--deep); color: #FFFFFF; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-search-control { min-width: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 15px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong); border-left: 0; border-radius: 0 4px 4px 0; background: var(--surface); } .ds-search-control:focus-within { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 35%, transparent); outline-offset: 1px; border-color: var(--accent); } .ds-search-control svg { width: 25px; height: 25px; flex: 0 0 auto; color: var(--ink); } .ds-search-control input { width: 100%; min-width: 0; height: 100%; padding: 0; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink); font: 500 18px Assistant, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-search-control input::placeholder { color: #0F5E54; opacity: 1; } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-search { height: 44px; grid-template-columns: 96px minmax(0, 1fr); } .ds-search-label { padding: 0 11px; font-size: 15px; } .ds-search-control { gap: 10px; padding: 8px 11px; } .ds-search-control svg { width: 21px; height: 21px; } .ds-search-control input { font-size: 15px; } }

components.name: Editor Field
components.description: Aligned label block and editable product value.
components.css: .ds-field { min-width: 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 140px minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: center; column-gap: 20px; margin-bottom: 10px; font-family: Assistant, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-field > span { min-height: 40px; display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 3px; background: var(--deep); color: #FFFFFF; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; min-width: 0; height: 40px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong); border-radius: 6px; background: #FFFFFF; color: var(--ink); font: 500 20px/1 Assistant, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-field input:focus { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 32%, transparent); outline-offset: 1px; border-color: var(--accent); } @media (max-width: 1080px) { .ds-field { grid-template-columns: 112px minmax(0, 1fr); column-gap: 12px; } .ds-field > span { padding: 0 12px; font-size: 16px; } } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-field { grid-template-columns: 88px minmax(0, 1fr); column-gap: 9px; } .ds-field > span { padding: 0 9px; font-size: 14px; } .ds-field input { font-size: 16px; } }

components.name: Tag Chip
components.description: Removable product tag inside the editor field.
components.css: .ds-tag { min-height: 30px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 2px 8px 2px 10px; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--tag); color: var(--ink); font: 500 16px/1 Assistant, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-tag button { width: 20px; height: 24px; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 3px; background: transparent; color: #14211F; font: 18px Assistant, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tag button:hover { background: #D6F3EC; } .ds-tag button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Stock Badge
components.description: Visible text and fill communicate inventory state.
components.css: .ds-stock-badge { min-width: 118px; min-height: 33px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 3px 13px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--status); color: var(--ink); font: 700 16px/1 Assistant, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-stock-badge-low { background: var(--status); } .ds-stock-badge-out { background: #C9211E; color: #FFFFFF; } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-stock-badge { min-width: 92px; min-height: 28px; padding: 3px 8px; font-size: 13px; } }

components.css: .ds-product-card { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr); grid-template-areas: 'product category' 'price stock' 'status status'; gap: 0 12px; padding: 7px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong); border-radius: 5px; background: var(--ground); color: var(--ink); font: 700 14px/1.2 Assistant, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms ease, color 120ms ease; } .ds-product-card:hover { background: #D6F3EC; } .ds-product-card:active { background: #B7C9C5; } .ds-product-card:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: -3px; } .ds-product-card-selected, .ds-product-card-selected:hover { border-color: var(--accent); background: var(--accent); color: #fff; } .ds-product-card-selected:active { background: #12302B; } .ds-product-cell { min-width: 0; padding: 4px 0; } .ds-product-name { grid-area: product; font-size: 16px; } .ds-product-category { grid-area: category; text-align: right; } .ds-product-price { grid-area: price; } .ds-product-stock { grid-area: stock; text-align: right; } .ds-product-status { grid-area: status; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-product-cell:not(.ds-product-name)::before { content: attr(data-label); display: inline-block; margin-right: 6px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .035em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-product-card-selected .ds-product-cell::before { color: #D6F3EC; } .ds-product-category::before { display: block; margin: 0 0 3px; text-align: right; } .ds-product-status::before { margin-right: 0; } .ds-product-card .ds-stock-badge { min-width: 92px; min-height: 28px; padding: 3px 8px; font-size: 13px; }

components.css: .ds-document-pane { min-width: 0; min-height: 552px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong); border-radius: 5px; background: #EEF2F1; font-family: Assistant, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-document-heading { min-height: 44px; display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 24px; background: var(--deep); color: #FFFFFF; font-size: 26px; line-height: 1; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -.018em; } .ds-document-code { height: 39vh; min-height: 360px; max-height: 420px; overflow: auto; margin: 20px 18px; padding: 14px 18px; border: 1px solid #0F5E54; border-radius: 6px; background: #EEF2F1; color: #D6F3EC; font: 500 18px/1.45 var(--font-code); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: pre; } .ds-document-code:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-document-pane { min-height: 0; } .ds-document-heading { min-height: 43px; padding: 0 16px; font-size: 22px; } .ds-document-code { height: 360px; min-height: 280px; margin: 14px; padding: 13px; font-size: 13px; } }

narrative.overview:
Records read as entries in a working register: aligned labels, deep-spruce rails, and a pale gray ground keep product, stock, and document structure easy to scan. Deep teal marks the selected record and primary actions; warm gold carries the sample and stock signals. Assistant handles interface text, while monospaced text is reserved for editable Specs and the MongoDB preview.

On wide screens, the five-column index spans the page, then the editor and nested document preview sit side by side. At narrow widths, search controls stack, rows become labeled product cards, and the editor and preview follow vertically. Borders, fills, and restrained corner radii carry depth; surfaces stay flat.
keyCharacteristics: Pale gray canvas, deep spruce ink, mint accents, and precise rules.
Deep teal for selection and primary action; warm gold for sample and stock signals.
Assistant interface type paired with monospaced Specs and JSON.
Catalogue index and paired record editor/document view, with a stacked mobile form.

rules.name: The Presentation Palette Rule
rules.body: Deep teal carries primary actions and selected records; warm gold remains a sample or stock marker.

rules.name: The Structured Text Rule
rules.body: Use monospace for Specs and the JSON document; keep ordinary controls and catalogue values in Assistant.

rules.name: The Paired Record Rule
rules.body: Keep the catalogue, editable record, and matching JSON document in one continuous workflow; pair the latter two on wide screens and stack them after the mobile card list.

rules.name: The Ruled Surface Rule
rules.body: Separate resting surfaces with fills and borders; do not add shadow as a default layer.

dos: Do use presentation teal for the primary action and selected catalogue record, and warm gold for sample/status marks.
Do keep prices and stock aligned with tabular figures and preserve the five-column index on wide layouts.
Do keep editable Specs and the MongoDB preview monospaced, with whitespace preserved.
Do retain a visible text label for each stock state.
Do keep the editor and document preview paired on wide screens and stacked after the catalogue on mobile.
donts: Don't use warm gold as a general action or selection color.
Don't add default shadows or decorative gradients; the system uses flat fills and rules.
Don't reduce stock states to color alone.
Don't turn the catalogue into a single-record feed; the product index remains part of the editing workflow.
